processes.name: Daily imbalance check routing and sign-off
processes.description: The daily imbalance check is a recurring task whose owner is unclear: Williams says Giron owns it, while Poorman says Williams holds sign-off. Numbers get sent to the wrong person and are walked over or forwarded by hand.
processes.stall_points: Ownership is contradicted between two messages sent a day apart, so numbers sent to one person must be forwarded or walked to the actual signer.
processes.automation: A named owner and an automated routing of the daily imbalance numbers to the approver with a sign-off record would remove the hand-offs.

processes.name: Deal counterparty correction chase (Deal 93836)
processes.description: Settlements staff need a deal ticket corrected before payments can go out. The request is passed through several people by forwarding the whole chain, and the requester chases for status.
processes.stall_points: The change request sat from Nov 15 to Nov 27 and was forwarded through four hands, with the requester chasing against a payment deadline.
processes.automation: A tracked deal-correction ticket with an owner and status would replace the forwarded email chain and manual chasers.

processes.name: Full month position meter confirmation by email paste
processes.description: The month position (scheduled vs actual by meter) is sent to the team, who each pull their own meters and confirm back. The attachment bounced, so the table was pasted into the email body.
processes.stall_points: Attachment bounces off the gateway and the data is re-sent inline; each recipient must manually filter their own meters and confirm by a deadline.
processes.automation: Publish the position to a shared location filtered by owner, with automatic variance flags and confirmation tracking.

processes.name: Enpower deal entry rules, deal numbers and nightly schedule checkouts
processes.description: The Portland desk enters deals in Enpower under written rules (EpmiCalPool deals), shares Enpower deal numbers by email, and checks out prescheduled paths with counterparties nightly. Rules and tool changes are communicated by email and corrected repeatedly.
processes.stall_points: EpmiCalPool deals keep causing problems with reports; deal numbers are forwarded by hand; checkouts require phone calls to dozens of counterparties between HE 19 and HE 21.
processes.automation: Validate deal-entry rules at entry in Enpower and auto-generate checkout lists and confirmation status instead of manual calls and emailed deal numbers.

processes.name: Transwestern contract amendment, credit and status processing
processes.description: Customer requests for receipt point changes or new service arrive by email, are approved, and are forwarded to contracts staff to generate amendments. Credit approval requests and a December 1 contract status list are circulated by email.
processes.stall_points: Customer revisions arrive after the original request and must be re-forwarded; status is compiled manually into an email list.
processes.automation: A request-to-amendment workflow with credit approval status and a generated contract status report.

processes.name: Meeting scheduling and call coordination
processes.description: Meetings and conference calls are arranged via calendar invites and forwarded notices, with attendees asking for confirmation and calling details afterwards.
processes.stall_points: Details are forwarded weeks later and recipients ask if the meeting is still on and for dial-in instructions.
processes.automation: Calendar invites with agenda and dial-in auto-attached and reminders, replacing forwarded notices and confirmation emails.

processes.name: Customer price quote requests and desk activity recap
processes.description: Customers email requests for forward gas quotes that must be checked with traders and answered by phone. The desk also writes a long daily recap of deals, ticket numbers and open issues for the manager.
processes.stall_points: Quote requests wait on trader availability, and when the contact is out of the office the customer buys from someone else. Recaps are written free-form.
processes.automation: A quote request intake with trader routing, and deal tickets summarized automatically from the deal system into the recap.
